name: fntasy-studio
description: Three independent Claude Code plugins: growth research with content tools, an independent design review of any interface, and an independent code reviewer

plugins.name: growth
plugins.description: Step-by-step growth research from open data: competitors, markets, Telegram channels, Central Asia, event kits. Content tools (posts, carousels, stories, reels with sound, content plan, UTM, weekly report) run from a clone

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design of interfaces, being rewritten from new materials. So far: ux-laws, 30 rules for screens on the principles of Laws of UX, each with a way to check it

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: An independent code reviewer with fresh eyes: acceptance criteria to file:line and tests, access, tenant isolation, money, migrations, secrets; runs lint, types and tests; verdict integrate or return
